svg.aria-label: Type at the end of a text, on disk. Insert one character at the end of a text that merges by position — the common keystroke. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); TinyBase (no text that merges by position); PouchDB (no text that merges by position); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (no text that merges by position); GUN (no text that merges by position); OrbitDB (no text that merges by position).
